instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME: FORCE LIGHT THEME. Do not implement dark mode toggle for MVP. The target audience (rural/elderly) prefers high contrast light mode.
2. LANGUAGE: Implement a persistent Language Toggle (English/Marathi) in the Header. Use a context provider for translation.
3. NAVIGATION: Use a bottom navigation bar for mobile (Home, Search, Bookmarks, Profile) and a top nav for desktop.
4. COMPONENTS: Use shadcn components from `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/`. Customize them with the colors defined above.
5. DATA: For 'Pre-populated government scheme data', create a `schemes.json` or `schemes.js` file with at least 5 dummy schemes per category. DO NOT fetch from an external empty API.
6. ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure all text has sufficient contrast. Use 'aria-label' for all icon buttons.
7. ELIGIBILITY CHECKER: Make it a step-by-step 'Wizard' form, not a long scrollable page.
8. SEARCH: Implement a real-time search filter for the scheme list.
9. TOASTS: Use 'sonner' for all notifications (e.g., 'Scheme Saved', 'Logged in').
10. ICONS: Use `lucide-react` (default) or `react-icons/fa` for category icons.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
accessibility_checklist: Color Contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text.
Alt Text: All images must have descriptive alt text.
Focus Indicators: Visible focus ring for keyboard navigation.
